name: Index query builder for Elasticsearch
description: Provides easier elasticsearch views query builder.
project_description: Index query builder for Elasticsearch (inqube) is a developer-facing module that lets Views run against an Elasticsearch cluster through the elasticsearch_helper client. It registers a Views query plugin ("Elasticsearch Query") whose actual query body is produced by a pluggable ElasticsearchQueryBuilder plugin, so each site provides its own builder class (extending the shipped BaseRootQueryBuilder / BaseIndexRootQueryBuilder abstractions or the trivial "default" builder) to translate a view's exposed filters, arguments and sorts into an Elasticsearch DSL query. Alongside the query plugin it supplies a synthetic "elasticsearch_result" Views base table with field handlers that pull values out of the _source object, render a matched Drupal entity in a view mode, turn source values into links, and an entity relationship that hydrates result rows into real entities (respecting entity view access). It ships no admin UI, routes, permissions or config schema; it is a base/integration layer meant to be extended in custom code.
